children: The yield on Italy's 12-month bills rose to a 25-month high at an auction on Wednesday.
The Treasury placed €7.5 billion ($8.72 billion) of a BOT bill expiring in September 2027 at a 2.967% yield, the highest since August 2024, up from 2.768% at a previous sale in August.
The Treasury also allotted €1.5 billion ($2.91 billion) in BOT bill maturing January 2027.
